title: Second regression: Michael lying opposite with small being between them
summary: Mario Woods tells of Second regression: Michael lying opposite with small being between them, about 1977 at aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: aboard craft near November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: whereas in regression number two I found out that Michael was laying opposite to me and there was one of the short ones or small ones between us

plain: A former US Air Force man named Mario Woods says he was taken aboard a craft in 1977 while serving in South Dakota. In his second regression, a kind of hypnosis session meant to bring back buried memories, linked to a woman named Yvonne Smith, he says he remembered a fellow serviceman, Michael Johnson, lying opposite him. Between them, he says, stood one of the short beings, which if true would put both men in the same encounter.
